india_rates.licence: FRED terms of use; underlying series (c) OECD. Free to redistribute with attribution.
india_rates.note: India immediate/call money interbank rate, monthly. Fetched from FRED's keyless CSV endpoint so the pipeline needs no credentials. Months FRED does not publish are dropped, never interpolated.
india_rates.publisher: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), series sourced from OECD / RBI

pulse_base_national.note: Registered users and registered merchants. PhonePe's own transactions, not all of UPI.

pulse_txn_national.note: P2P / Retail (merchant) / Utility split. PhonePe's own transactions, not all of UPI.

pulse_txn_state.note: State-level transaction count and value. PhonePe's own transactions, not all of UPI.

pulse_txn_state_mix.note: P2P / merchant / utility split within each state, from the per-state aggregated endpoint. Reconciled against the country file. PhonePe's own transactions, not all of UPI.

upi_apps.licence: NPCI terms apply to the underlying data
upi_apps.note: Top ten apps by volume, transcribed from a browser session because NPCI returns HTTP 403 to scripted access. Shares are computed against the NPCI national monthly total, so they are true market shares and the residual is real.

upi_monthly.licence: NPCI terms apply to the underlying data
upi_monthly.note: CKAN mirror STOPS AT 2023-08. Rows after that are hand-seeded from npci.org.in, which returns HTTP 403 to scripted access. The `provenance` column marks which is which.
